On the field with our pupils

Three medallists take their places on the podium at the 2026 Annual Sports Day. The school album also follows pupils into the race lanes, onto the lawn for an inter-house dance and behind an NCC exhibition table.

Sport and danceMeet the housesNCC

Sports and performance

A chair in every lane

At the 2026 Sports Day, pupils in house colours bend over small chairs, one in each chalk lane. Look at the line of red, yellow and green chairs stretching across the track.

The programme for Sports Day on 10 February 2025 included sprints, relays and tug of war. Read the 2025 report

Sports photographs

Inter-house dance

Watch how the group steps across the grass and turns together. As the dancers turn, their yellow skirts flare and the pink sashes swing.

Dance and performance photographs

Four houses, four colours

The houses carry names from Mewar’s history. Each has a colour of its own. At the inter-house dance competition, pupils perform together on the school lawn.

  • Rana PratapRed
  • Rana KumbhaBlue
  • Rana SangaYellow
  • Bappa RawalGreen

NCC

Cadets at the exhibition

At a 2022 school exhibition, National Cadet Corps cadets stood beside a table of handwritten cards. In khaki uniforms and striped sashes, they showed the display to a visitor.

The programme for Sports Day on 27 January 2026 listed a torch relay, the sports oath and recognition for cadets who earned the NCC A certificate.

Families interested in NCC can ask the office about this session’s enrolment, eligible classes and activities.

Ask the school office
Have a question about the school?Classes, fees and visits+
Where should we start for a young child?

Start with Nursery or KG. The office can help decide the appropriate class and explain age eligibility.

See the early-years guide
What are the current fees?

Fees depend on the class. Ask the office for tuition and any separate costs for books, uniform or transport. You can request a written fee breakdown.

Contact the office
How do we visit the campus?

Find the school opposite Mela Ground in Amet. Call before travelling so the office can confirm a suitable time.

Directions and visit details
What can we choose in Class 11?

Science, Commerce and Arts are the school’s streams. Ask the office to confirm individual subjects, eligibility and availability.
